description: Review/audit reply: a verdict plus finding blocks, per AGENTS.md § Replies.

verdict.description: lgtm only after a full sweep of the stated scope produced zero findings.

swept.description: One line naming what was actually swept (files, hunks, checks), so the verdict is auditable.

findings.description: Empty exactly when verdict is lgtm. Ordered by severity, blocker first.

severity.description: blocker: wrong results, data loss, exploitable. major: a real defect off the happy path. minor: works, but fragile or misleading. nit: style.

cite.description: Evidence address: file:line for a repo claim; the exact command plus the relevant output line for a runtime claim; URL or section for an external doc.

fix.description: The concrete fix, specific enough to apply without re-deriving the analysis.

unverified.description: Why the claim could not be verified against its cite; null when verified.
